🚦 Traffic Advisory – Republic Day 2026 🇮🇳

🗓️ 26-01-2026 | ⏰ 07:00 AM – 12:00 PM
📍 Parade Grounds, Secunderabad

Traffic diversions will be in force due to Republic Day celebrations.
Public are advised to avoid Panjagutta–Greenlands–Begumpet routes and surrounding roads of Parade Grounds.
🚫 Tivoli X-Roads to Plaza X-Roads will remain closed.

Heavy traffic is expected at major junctions in Secunderabad and Begumpet areas.
🚆 Commuters are requested to start early and use Metro Rail services.

Please cooperate with Traffic Police.
